say:2:1360208001:0.text: Phew, thanks for stepping in. What can I do for you all?
say:2:1360208001:0.source_cn: 呼，多谢相助。你们怎么会突然来这里，有事找我吗？

say:5:1360208003:1.text: I heard... Huh? Hmm... Oh! Actually, it's nothing worth mentioning...
say:5:1360208003:1.source_cn: 听到风……啊？嗯？哦！哦哦，其实没什么大事！

say:6:1360208005:1.text: W-Well, with spring fast approaching, I really miss the forest, but it's not quite time to return to the Dark Forest yet...

say:7:1360208006:1.text: So... Um... Ah! I came up with a song!
say:7:1360208006:1.source_cn: 所以，呃，怎么回事呢，所以呢……对了！我想了一首新曲子！

say:8:1360208007:1.text: This song is most beautiful when played in a forest. Also, only Wilders can appreciate its wonders.
say:8:1360208007:1.source_cn: 这首美妙的新曲子只有在森林中演奏才能达到最绝妙的效果，...
